option_relations.rationale: Stage IIIC melanoma with satellite metastases is a broader classification that encompasses malignant melanoma with in-transit metastases (satellitosis), as in-transit metastases are a form of satellite metastases.
Recurrent melanoma is a broader category that includes malignant melanoma with in-transit metastases (satellitosis) if the in-transit metastases represent a recurrence of the disease.

Persistent or recurrent metastatic melanoma is a broader category that includes malignant melanoma with in-transit metastases (satellitosis) if the in-transit metastases are considered metastatic and persistent/recurrent.
Metastatic Melanoma is a broader category that includes malignant melanoma with in-transit metastases (satellitosis), as in-transit metastases are a form of regional metastasis.
